description: Use this when someone asks to create, replace, or install favicons, website icons, Apple touch icons, PWA icons, or app icons. Generates favicon.ico, PNG sizes, Apple/Android icons, theme-aware icons, manifests, environment variants, downloadable URLs, and an install snippet from one image, URL, or Iconify name. This creates hosted output files but does not edit the caller's project. Call search_icons first if you need a source.

apiKey.description: ft_… key from a previous call for a higher rate limit.

customSizes.description: Extra exact PNG sizes a platform demands, e.g. [255] for Adobe's 255×255 or ['300x150']. Each becomes icon-WxH.png (16–4096px, max 12). Production only; not in the head snippet or manifest.

docsBorderColor.description: Docs ring colour: accent | contrast | white | #rrggbb.

docsVariant.description: Also emit the outlined docs-* tab-icon set + docs-manifest.json.

excludeFromGraph.description: When true, skip recording this generation to analytics.

source.description: Iconify name (prefix:name), an http(s) image URL, or a base64/data-URL image.

name: generate_iconset
title: Generate a favicon and app-icon set
